The '''''Gladiator I''-class Star Destroyer''' was the first sub-class of the [[Gladiator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Gladiator''-class]] line of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was succeeded by the [[Gladiator II-class Star Destroyer|''Gladiator II''-class Star Destroyer]].
